# BCGov Crow - v0.15.1

## Release type

Patch release

## Summary

Added PHP guidance to existing Crow architecture, development, testing, CI,
and security-review skills without changing their invocation contracts.

## Highlights

- Route ten PHP modules by workload across application architecture,
  implementation, tests, diagnostics, and security review.
- Support PHP CI across GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, and Jenkins using
  Composer lockfile and audit checks, existing test suites, and conditional
  SonarQube Clover coverage import.
- Cover PHP runtime and framework lifecycle, native versus framework-managed
  sessions, safe persistence, uploads, web-server/FPM boundaries, and
  reproducible builds.
- Recognize Composer audits in the security CI gate inventory and verify the
  change with a focused regression test.
- Align full-package, plugin, and collection versions at 0.15.1.

## Artifacts

- Archive: `bcgov-crow-0.15.1.zip`

## Installation

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.15.1 --global --target copilot
```
